name: navbar-pill-glide
title: Navbar Pill Glide
description: A navbar with its links in a frosted pill, where a soft highlight glides to whichever link you point at and a lime line along the pill tracks how far down the page you are. The logo dot circles its ring as you scroll, the bar slips away going down, and on narrow screens a round toggle wipes the full menu open from where it sits, with large rolling links and a poster that swaps as you hover them.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/navbar-pill-glide
Pass your own `links` and put your page inside as `children`; every link but home goes in the pill, and all of them fill the mobile menu.
